agent_notes: Government-directory verification succeeded: Aligarh Muslim University appears in each supplied NIRF 2025 category listing, with city Aligarh.

The official homepage, facts page, and visit page establish the Aligarh main campus and district. Explicitly location-labelled Malappuram, Murshidabad, and Kishanganj programme variants were excluded from this Aligarh campus record.

The official Guide to Admissions 2026-27 is used as the central active catalogue; the official Centre for Skill Development and Career Planning page supplies the named professional certificate courses omitted from the guide's generic Certificate Courses heading.
Specializations shown as semicolon-separated values preserve the exact official bullet labels while keeping one catalogue record per official programme family.
Duration and eligibility are null unless explicitly stated on the official page; the skill-centre counselling diploma and certificate eligibility are populated from the official skill-centre page.

Normal TLS verification encountered the managed proxy's self-signed certificate-chain error. Public GET requests then used curl --insecure only for the expected official NIRF, AMU, and AMU Controller of Examinations hosts.
